descriptions.text: Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph. This kit contains 12 essential items for proper foot care. The magical enhancements of this item may only be imbued within a Safe or Personal Space. Warning: All of these enhancements require you to remain barefoot. Why? Because you know why. From a pumice stone to a cuticle pusher, this personal hygiene kit will keep your feet both luscious and in perfect fighting shape. Nightly care of your feet and toenails will result in the following bonuses: +15% Damage to bare-foot attacks for 30 hours. +3 to the Smush skill for 30 hours. +Unbreakable buff (feet only) for 30 hours. This buff keeps your pretty little metatarsals nice and unbroken. …

recap.text: Carl pulls the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph from the haul, a zippered black folder of miniature tools that works only while he stays barefoot. Imani, not the laughing Donut, explains the tools, and he learns he only has to make a show of using them. A table that should have severed his feet at the ankles bounces off and breaks his legs instead, and he wakes healed by Donut's scroll, his toes sparkling.

Carl's level-six baby chomps onto his foot on the red line, and at first it does nothing, then he cries out in pain as it gnaws on the meat of his sole. He stamps it into a burst of tomato soup, spreads his toes to check they are all there, and heals. His pedicure buffs have expired, and he had forgotten what it felt like to be vulnerable down there.

Carl finds more achievements waiting than he expected, including one for killing a swordfish guy with his foot, worth a bronze spicy box. His Smush base sits at level twelve, and the pedicure kit's bonus is supposed to add three, yet the skill still reads fourteen. Skills always go wonky when item buffs push them toward fifteen. The card fights pay seriously padded experience.

Inside the stinking kangaroo costume, with his boxers and kneepads worn on the outside of it, Carl gets two warnings at once: the costume has negated his boxer effects, and it has negated his pedicure effects. He pulls a banger sphere from his inventory, praying it will appear outside the costume and not in his hand under the skin. It appears in the paw.

beats.headline: One last item
beats.text: Carl has one last item to examine from the haul, and he swears under his breath before he has even pulled it into his hand: a little black folder with a zipper, full of miniature tools. Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph, twelve essential items for proper foot care, working only in a safe room or personal space and only while he stays barefoot. He sighs. The very last buff, an alarm and a five-second delay before any trap set off by a footfall, is a great prize.
beats.gist: Carl examines the Pedicure Kit of the Sylph, whose last buff delays footfall traps.

beats.headline: Imani shows him how
beats.text: Little sharp rocks are everywhere. Carl kicks one away, and below him his shiny toes glitter. He had tried to get Donut to show him how to use the kit, and she laughed at him. It was Imani, of all people, who sat down with him, pulling the tools out one at a time and matter-of-factly explaining how they worked. The buffs activate after about fifteen minutes of work. He doesn't need to use every tool. He just has to make a show of it.
beats.gist: Carl learns from Imani that his pedicure kit's buffs start after fifteen minutes of shown effort.

beats.headline: Saved by a pedicure
beats.text: Carl wakes in the hallway, healed by one of Donut's healing scrolls, his one-armed jacket scorched to hell. His toes sparkle. He thinks he was saved by that damn pedicure kit. The table should have severed his feet right at the ankles. Instead it bounced off and broke his legs, and without that, he would have bled out.
beats.gist: Carl wakes healed by Donut's scroll and credits the pedicure kit for saving him.

beats.headline: The buffs ran out
beats.text: On the red line, a level-six baby chomps onto Carl's foot, which should do nothing because of his… and then he is crying out in excruciating pain as it gnaws on the meat of his sole. He stamps it into a burst of tomato soup, spreads his toes to check they are all there, and heals. It has been a long time since he let his pedicure buffs expire. He had forgotten what it felt like to be vulnerable down there.
beats.gist: Carl's expired pedicure buffs let a level-six baby gnaw his sole until he stamps it.

beats.headline: Stuck at fourteen
beats.text: Among more achievements than he expected is one for killing a swordfish guy with his foot, worth a bronze spicy box. Carl's Smush base is now level twelve. His bonus for using the pedicure kit supposedly raises it three more, but the skill is still listed as fourteen. As always, skills go wonky when item buffs try to push them toward fifteen. And these card fights are paying seriously padded experience.
beats.gist: Carl's Smush skill stays listed at fourteen, though his pedicure kit bonus should raise it to fifteen.

beats.headline: Negated by a costume
beats.text: Inside the stinking kangaroo costume, his boxers and kneepads somehow on the outside of it, Carl gets two warnings at once: his boxer effects have been negated by his costume, and so have his pedicure effects. He pulls a banger sphere from his inventory, praying it will appear outside the costume and not in his hand under the skin. It appears in the paw.
beats.gist: Carl's kangaroo costume negates his boxer and pedicure effects, and his banger sphere appears in the paw.
